description: This Java source file defines the DashboardWebSocketHandler class, which manages WebSocket connections for a dashboard in the MockServer project. It handles WebSocket upgrades, message processing, and updates to connected clients based on server logs and request matchers.

classes.name: DashboardWebSocketHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication for the MockServer dashboard, managing WebSocket upgrades, message handling, and client updates.

methods.name: handlerAdded
methods.description: Initializes scheduler thread pool when handler is added.

methods.name: handlerRemoved
methods.description: Shuts down thread pools when handler is removed.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, handling WebSocket upgrade requests and frames.

methods.name: channelReadComplete
methods.description: Flushes the channel after read completion.

methods.name: upgradeChannel
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake and upgrades the connection.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Sets up serializers, loggers, and registers log and matcher listeners.

methods.name: handleWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Handles different WebSocket frame types: close, text, ping.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the client with retry logic.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Unregisters listeners and cleans up when channel becomes inactive.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Updates clients with latest logs and request matchers.

methods.name: sendUpdate
methods.description: Prepares and sends update data to clients based on logs and request matchers.
